components.name: Proof Card
components.description: Framed evidence surface for metrics and service narratives.

narrative.overview: The site treats restoration marketing like a working signal system: cobalt fields carry the promise, chalk surfaces carry the explanation, and mustard marks show where to act. A fine tile-seam grid gives the pages a repeatable material language without turning the interface into a decorative pattern exercise.
keyCharacteristics: Mustard as a scarce directional signal

rules.name: The Signal Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Mustard is a directional signal, not a fill color for whole sections.

rules.name: The Big Promise Rule
rules.body: Let the first viewport state the value plainly before secondary explanation begins.

rules.name: The Structural Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows support hierarchy; they do not turn every component into a floating pill.

dos: Do use dark cobalt to introduce a promise, mechanism, or proof moment.
Do keep actions rectangular, specific, and easy to find.
donts: Don't turn every surface into a card or every action into a pill.
Don't let the tile grid overpower copy, evidence, or form completion.
